primary_estimate: canonical run (seed 42 for trained models, single LLM run); 95% paired percentile bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, seed 42

paper_tables_m1_data_splits.csv.description: Class distribution of every split and duplicates of Train ∪ Validation.

paper_tables_m2_split_id_overlaps.csv.description: Shared review IDs between splits (all zero).

paper_tables_m3_fewshot_exemplars.csv.description: Few-shot exemplars of every prompt: count, classes, membership in Train, selection rule.

paper_tables_m4_configurations.csv.description: Every configuration: 28 of the joint scoring (5 cascades, 5 flat, 18 hybrids), 2 hybrids not scored and the exploratory additions of v4.1 and v4.2.

paper_tables_rq1_e2e.csv.description: End-to-end four-class results of the ten pure configurations on the Shopee hold-out and Lazada (canonical run).

paper_tables_rq1_focused_e2e.csv.description: End-to-end results on the FEATURE/UX-enriched Shopee focused set (descriptive; LLM tier 1 was not run on this set).

paper_tables_rq1_tier1.csv.description: Tier 1 (ACTIONABLE vs NOT_ACTIONABLE) on the Shopee hold-out and Lazada, canonical run with 95% CIs.

paper_tables_rq1_tier2.csv.description: Tier 2 (BUG/FEATURE/UX) on gold-actionable reviews of the Shopee hold-out (183) and the focused set, canonical run with 95% CI.

paper_tables_rq1_tier_mcnemar.csv.description: Exact McNemar tests between strategies at tier 1 and tier 2 (Holm within each tier family).

paper_tables_rq1_pairs.csv.description: Main pairwise comparisons of RQ1: paired bootstrap difference of Macro-F1 with 95% CI and exact McNemar, Holm over the registered 378-pair family.

paper_tables_app_pairs_all.csv.description: Supplement: all 378 pairwise comparisons of the 28 configurations on each set.

paper_tables_rq1_dedup.csv.description: Shopee hold-out after removing reviews whose normalised text occurs in Train ∪ Validation (217) and near duplicates (cosine ≥ 0.90, 17); Spearman rank correlation with the full hold-out 0.979 and 0.979.
percent_columns: Macro-F1 without exact and near duplicates (n = 766)

paper_tables_rq1_prompt_variant.csv.description: Original prompt v1 against the app-neutral prompt v1n on Lazada (single LLM runs, GPT-4o-mini).

paper_tables_rq1_prompt_variant_pairs.cs.description: Differences v1n − v1 with paired bootstrap 95% CI and McNemar p (Holm over the six pairs of the variant family).

paper_tables_rq1_error_coding.csv.description: Manual coding of OTHER reviews that the LLM labelled actionable (share of each model’s coded errors).

paper_tables_rq1_error_contribution.csv.description: Contribution of each category to the false-actionable rate on gold-OTHER reviews; policy, account and order complaints explain 9.0 of the 9.5 points (cascade) of the Lazada − hold-out gap.

paper_tables_rq2_architecture.csv.description: Architecture under the same decision policy: flat (argmax), thresholded flat and cascade of every strategy, with paired differences (95% CI) and Holm-adjusted McNemar p within the registered families.

paper_tables_rq2_b1_configurations.csv.description: Full results of the flat, thresholded flat and cascade configurations of the four trained strategies (focused set descriptive).

paper_tables_rq2_b1_thresholds.csv.description: Thresholds of the thresholded flat models chosen on validation (seed 42) with the guarded tier-1 rule.

paper_tables_rq2_b1_pairs.csv.description: B1 pairwise comparisons (thresholded − flat; cascade − thresholded) with Holm within each set.

paper_tables_rq2_routing.csv.description: Routing policies to the flat LLM with PhoBERT as the small model, against the flat references and random routing with the same number of LLM calls (canonical run; random routing: 1,000 draws).

paper_tables_rq2_routing_pairs.csv.description: Pairwise comparisons of the routing policies; Holm within the registered v4.1 routing family (24 pairs per set) and B2 family (7 pairs per set).

paper_tables_app_routing_other_small.csv.description: Supplement: confidence routing with TF-IDF and ViSoBERT as the small model.

paper_tables_rq1_transfer.csv.description: Transfer from the Shopee hold-out to Lazada: canonical-run Macro-F1 of the pure configurations, the best class-routed hybrid and the PhoBERT routers.

paper_tables_app_calibration.csv.description: Supplement: cascades with a temperature-scaled tier 1 against the locked cascades.

paper_tables_app_calibration_pairs.csv.description: Supplement: calibrated − locked cascade, Holm within each set.

paper_tables_app_calibration_ece.csv.description: Supplement: expected calibration error of the tier-1 ACTIONABLE probability (15 equal-width bins).

paper_tables_rq3_cost_drivers.csv.description: Measured cost drivers of representative configurations and their fixed and variable cost at USD 0.10 per label and USD 0.35 per GPU hour.

paper_tables_rq3_break_even.csv.description: Monthly volume above which configuration A becomes cheaper than the LLM configuration B over 12 months.

paper_tables_rq3_cheapest.csv.description: Cheapest configuration reaching a Macro-F1 target over 12 months in every scenario (costs within 1% or USD 10 count as equal; the higher Macro-F1 wins).

paper_tables_rq3_target_sensitivity.csv.description: Cheapest configuration for Macro-F1 targets of 78, 79 and 80 with the canonical-run Macro-F1 (main) and with the three-seed mean (sensitivity), USD 0.10 per label, USD 0.35 per GPU hour.

paper_tables_rq3_existing_labels.csv.description: Organisation that already owns the initial labels (initial labels free, drift-check labels still paid); no cheapest-configuration cell of the base grid changes (0 of 48).

paper_tables_rq3_llm_price.csv.description: Break-even volumes when the LLM price is multiplied by 1, 5 and 20 (USD 0.10 per label, USD 0.35 per GPU hour).

paper_tables_rq3_routing_rates.csv.description: PhoBERT ⇢ LLM (θmax) costed with the LLM share of each test set (hold-out 12.2%, Lazada 19.2%, canonical run), PhoBERT inference included.

paper_tables_rq3_observed_scale.csv.description: Observed collection scale: 57,200 reviews per year (about 4,767 per month), USD 0.10 per label, batch deployment; labelling and computation only, specialist labour and the cost of missed reviews are not included.

paper_tables_rq3_parameters.csv.description: Parameters of the cost model with unit, value, status (measured or assumed) and source.

paper_tables_app_per_seed.csv.description: Macro-F1 of every seed of the multi-run configurations, three-seed mean ± SD and the gap to the canonical run.

paper_tables_app_all_configurations.csv.description: Supplement: all 28 configurations on both sets with measured cost and Pareto membership (Figure of quality against cost).

paper_tables_app_errors.csv.description: Supplement: end-to-end errors of the canonical run split by stage.

paper_tables_app_confusion.csv.description: Supplement: confusion matrices (gold × predicted) of the canonical runs of key configurations.

paper_tables_fig_routing_en.png.description: Hold-out macro-F1 of PhoBERT ⇢ LLM against the share of reviews sent to the LLM, random routing with the same number of calls and the registered routers (canonical run).

paper_tables_fig_cost_tco_en.png.description: Total cost over 12 months against monthly volume at USD 0.10 per label and USD 0.35 per GPU hour, batch and always-on deployment.
